All Master Sales Agreements executed globally by Adventure Works Cycles must explicitly denote the settlement currency. The authorized framework consists of the following parameters:
• Base Standard Settlement Currency: United States Dollar (USD) serves as the primary currency for all international invoices to streamline treasury aggregation.
• Approved Regional Currencies: Transactions executed in Euro (EUR), Australian Dollar (AUD), British Pound (GBP), or Canadian Dollar (CAD) are allowed only if structured using standard price lists indexed dynamically to the corporate monthly treasury rate.
• FX Volatility Risk Mitigation: For any multi-year supply contract exceeding $1,000,000 USD invoiced in non-USD currency, a mandatory Forex Hedging and Currency Risk clause must be integrated, requiring a price adjustment review if the currency fluctuates by more than 3% against the USD.

sql_queries:
WITH max_order AS (
  SELECT 
    soh.salesorderid,
    soh.totaldue
  FROM 
    adventureworks_dataagent.sales.store s
    JOIN adventureworks_dataagent.sales.customer c ON s.businessentityid = c.storeid
    JOIN adventureworks_dataagent.sales.salesorderheader soh ON c.customerid = soh.customerid
  WHERE s.name = 'Vigorous Exercise Company' AND soh.totaldue IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY soh.totaldue DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  max_order.salesorderid,
  max_order.totaldue,
  compliance_result.compliance_status,
  compliance_result.settlement_allowed,
  compliance_result.required_controls,
  compliance_result.currency_approved,
  compliance_result.fx_hedging_clause_required
FROM max_order
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT adventureworks_dataagent.salesduo_agent_tools.check_large_transaction_compliance(
    'WIRE_TRANSFER',
    max_order.totaldue,
    'EUR',
    2
  ) AS compliance_result
)
